message:
The full poster now renders completely within the visible area. Everything checks out:

- **Header rail** — both ends visible, 「季节构成 · 02」left, 「MUSE 内置样板 ／ CONCEPT SAMPLE」right.
- **Hero type** — 「春日」in dark-on-朱红 blue block, uncropped, with the red accent circle anchoring the lower-right corner of the block.
- **Secondary title** — 「自有节奏」held between two hairlines, creating the big-type/hairline contrast that carries the theme.
- **Spec chip** — four cells complete, disclosure line 「概念示例 · 非真实项目」legible.
- **Beat band** — original and structurally sound: five blue barlines with the pink 「柔板」mass in measure 01, three-beat groups, the 朱红 breakout beat rising well clear of measure 03 with its leader line to 「这一拍，自己走」, the rest block in measure 04, and the closing 收束 line.
- **Labels** — 小节 01–04 and 休止 all readable.
- **Footer** — the required disclosure 「概念示例：品牌、项目与数据均为虚构，不代表真实客户案例」sits safely inside the frame.

The poster is delivered. A few notes on what's verified and what isn't:

**Verified by actual rendering:** the full 1440×900 composition is visible with no content clipped; all 中文 titles («春日», «自有节奏») render correctly and legibly; the measure structure reads left-to-right as intended; the disclosure and concept labels are present and readable at this scale.

**Not verified:** narrow-screen/mobile behavior and any interactive path — this is a static poster, so there is no interaction to test. I also chose to keep all essential content inside a ~1280px-wide safety box after the first two renders showed the host cropping the right edge; that decision is based on observed rendering, not assumption.

**Where you can take it next:** the poster's geometry is parameterized by hand — you can ask me to change the number of measures, shift the breakout beat to a different position, swap the 朱红/钴蓝 roles, or add a version at square/portrait ratios, and I'll keep the same measure-line logic and three-color discipline.
